dedupe_keys.name: 50 years of inland waterway freight data in the rhine alpine corridor 1970 to 2023

description: This dataset is a harmonised 50-year time series of inland waterway transport (IWT) freight in Europe, focused on the Rhine-Alpine Corridor, where about 70 percent of EU inland waterway activity takes place. One file gives total annual transport performance (billion tonne-kilometres) per EU country from 1970 to 2023; the other gives annual transport volumes (thousand tonnes) per country and goods type in the NST-R, NST 2007 and CCR classifications, with Dutch loading and unloading regions at NUTS-2 level from 1988. It was compiled by researchers of Delft University of Technology and Rijkswaterstaat from national statistical offices (CBS, Destatis), Eurostat and OECD, using imputation and optical character recognition of older publications, and described in Scientific Data (13:472, February 2026). Coverage is continental, by country and year, with goods-type detail that differs between countries. The CSV files are free on Zenodo (v1.0.0 of 23 January 2026, 110 MB zip including the processing code) and GitHub under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: volumes cannot be summed over countries because of duplicated flows, the goods classification breaks in 2007, and imputed years carry uncertainty. The data support long-run demand analysis, network flow and capacity planning studies of inland shipping and calibration of freight models, and relate to the OpenTNSim waterway model from the same group, catalogued here.
